Product description

Upgrade your smartphone protection with the ShieldTech MagStand Series Case for Samsung Galaxy S25 5G, designed to deliver durability, functionality, and premium style in one. This case is crafted using a high quality TPU + PC hybrid material, ensuring long lasting protection against daily wear, drops, and scratches. The highlight feature of this case is the sliding camera shield which provides enhanced protection to your Samsung Galaxy S25 5G camera lens by preventing scratches dust and damage when not in use. This makes it ideal for users who want extra camera safety without compromising on design. Equipped with a built in magnetic ring this case is fully Mag-Safe compatible allowing seamless wireless charging and strong magnetic attachment with Mag-Safe accessories. No need to remove the case while charging. The case also features an integrated kickstand enabling hands free viewing for videos calls or browsing. Whether you are watching content or attending meetings this stand adds extra convenience to your daily usage. With precise cutouts and responsive buttons you get easy access to all ports speakers and controls without any obstruction. The snug fit design ensures your Samsung Galaxy S25 5G stays secure while maintaining a sleek and modern look. If you're looking for a case that combines style protection and smart functionality the ShieldTech MagStand Series is the perfect choice for your Samsung Galaxy S25 5G.

About this Item

  • Compatible with Samsung Galaxy S25 5G : Specifically designed to perfectly fit and protect your Samsung Galaxy S25 5G
  • MagSafe Compatibility : Built in magnets ensure seamless Mag-Safe charging and accessory support
  • Sliding Camera Shield : Safeguard your camera lens from scratches and dust with the easy to use sliding cover
  • Built In Stand : Enjoy hands free viewing with the integrated stand perfect for video calls and streaming
  • Shockproof Durability : Robust TPU and PC materials protect your device from accidental drops and impacts

Product description

Upgrade your smartphone protection with the ShieldTech MagStand Series Case for Samsung Galaxy S25 5G, designed to deliver durability, functionality, and premium style in one. This case is crafted using a high quality TPU + PC hybrid material, ensuring long lasting protection against daily wear, drops, and scratches. The highlight feature of this case is the sliding camera shield which provides enhanced protection to your Samsung Galaxy S25 5G camera lens by preventing scratches dust and damage when not in use. This makes it ideal for users who want extra camera safety without compromising on design. Equipped with a built in magnetic ring this case is fully Mag-Safe compatible allowing seamless wireless charging and strong magnetic attachment with Mag-Safe accessories. No need to remove the case while charging. The case also features an integrated kickstand enabling hands free viewing for videos calls or browsing. Whether you are watching content or attending meetings this stand adds extra convenience to your daily usage. With precise cutouts and responsive buttons you get easy access to all ports speakers and controls without any obstruction. The snug fit design ensures your Samsung Galaxy S25 5G stays secure while maintaining a sleek and modern look. If you're looking for a case that combines style protection and smart functionality the ShieldTech MagStand Series is the perfect choice for your Samsung Galaxy S25 5G.
